description: Store ONE e-mail in a mailbox of this tenant without contacting any mail server — for simulations and for the local Thunderbird bridge. Nothing is sent or fetched. Idempotent per mailbox on message_id (a second call with the same message_id returns the stored mail). Without message_id a stable id is derived from sender, subject, date and body. email_account_id defaults to the tenant's first mailbox; the mailbox needs no credentials. Required: from_address. body is stored in full (get_email returns it); body_preview keeps the first 4000 characters. status 'new'. Returns { ingested, email_id, email_account_id, message_id }.

message_id.description: RFC Message-ID; de-dupe key per mailbox

name: ingest_email
